author: hattrill
body:
spoke too soon - this is a SwissProt annotation. @pgaudet could you update P36179 PMID:32966759 from protein phosphatase regulator activity  (IDA) -> protein complex scaffold activity 
"The structure of PP2A has been determined and reveals that PR65 contains 15 HEAT repeats that function as a scaffold for association of the PP2Ac and B subunits "
In this paper, it is acting to bridge PP2A and the Intergrator complex, so GO:0030674 protein-macromolecule adaptor activity would be might be more appropriate, but as it forming a Integrator-PP2A complex to target pol II CTD, I think that  protein complex scaffold activity should be ok.
